verified_facts.text: The Landings sits on the shores of Rodney Bay in Saint Lucia, along one of the island's most celebrated beaches.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tucked on the shores of Saint Lucia’s iconic Rodney Bay, along one of the island's most celebrated beaches

verified_facts.text: The Landings is an all-suite resort set beachfront on white sands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set beachfront on pristine white sands and azure waters, sophistication meets island authenticity at our exquisite all-suite resort.

verified_facts.text: Each villa has an expansive terrace with views of the marina or the Caribbean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: each villa boasts expansive terraces and stunning views of the Marina or the Caribbean Sea

verified_facts.text: Many of the villas have private plunge pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: with many offering private plunge pools and exclusive butler service

verified_facts.text: The suites are multi-room, with kitchens and living areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: From exceptionally spacious, multi-room suites with kitchens and living areas to swimming pools, a fabulous beach, and activities and experiences for all ages

verified_facts.text: The suites feature workspaces and private terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: With exceptionally spacious suites featuring kitchens, workspaces, and private terraces

verified_facts.text: A private marina flows through the heart of the resort and is the departure point for dive trips, snorkel tours and sightseeing charters.
verified_facts.excerpt: At The Landings, a modern, private marina flows through the heart of the resort. A favorite feature for seafaring guests and the departure point for dive trips, snorkel tours, and sightseeing charters

verified_facts.text: Butler service is included with Beachfront and Ocean View Suites and available with Marina View Suites on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Included with our Beachfront and Ocean View Suite and available with Marina View on request, your personal butler is a trusted assistant and guide

verified_facts.text: The spa is on the second floor of the resort lobby and has eight treatment rooms and outdoor hydrotherapy terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the second floor of the resort lobby, our full-service Spa in Saint Lucia offers a deceptively expansive and serene setting, featuring eight luxurious treatment rooms, outdoor hydrotherapy terraces

verified_facts.text: The spa uses services and products from Natura Bisse.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa at the Landings offers an array of services and products from Natura Bisse

verified_facts.text: The spa's Signature Bamboo Massage Ritual is a locally sourced and produced therapy derived from Saint Lucia's national plant.
verified_facts.excerpt: This locally sourced and produced therapy, derived from the national plant of Saint Lucia, focuses on women’s health and wellness.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers personalized treatments for issues such as menopause, hormonal imbalances, postpartum recovery, aging and menstrual discomfort.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa specializes in enhancing well-being through personalized treatments tailored to address issues such as menopause, hormonal imbalances, postpartum recovery, aging, and menstrual discomfort.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers oncology-focused treatments performed by oncology-trained therapists.
verified_facts.excerpt: Performed by oncology-trained therapists, these comforting and replenishing treatments address the unique needs of sensitized skin

verified_facts.text: The Kids Club, included in the stay, welcomes children aged 4 to 12, seven days a week.
verified_facts.excerpt: Included in your stay, we welcome children aged 4 – 12, 7 days a week

verified_facts.text: The Teens Program is seasonal.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Landings Resort and Spa’s seasonal Teens Program motivates teenagers with action, fun, and age-specific activities.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers babysitting services and baby proofing for all villa suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: is also pleased to offer babysitting services and baby proofing for all villa suites

verified_facts.text: The grounds are manicured with flat, walkable terrain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meticulously manicured grounds with flat, walkable terrain

verified_facts.text: Meals feature fresh catch and organic, sustainable produce sourced from the Caribbean and the hills of Saint Lucia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sourced from the warm waters of the Caribbean and the lush hills of Saint Lucia, every meal features the freshest catch and organic and sustainable produce and ingredients.

verified_facts.text: Suru serves Asian fusion cuisine and handcrafted cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Suru

Asian Fusion Cuisine & Handcrafted Cocktail

verified_facts.text: Guests can arrange romantic dinners on the beach and en-suite entertaining with a personal chef.
verified_facts.excerpt: From a poolside lunch or romantic dinner on the beach to full-service villa provisioning and en-suite entertaining with a personal chef

verified_facts.text: The resort's romantic sunset cruise sails to Marigot Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set sail for Marigot Bay—known as the most beautiful bay in the Caribbean—as you enjoy a romantic soundtrack, sip on cocktails and wine from the fully stocked bar

verified_facts.text: Sports and fitness programs include daily workouts, personal training, racket sports and group yoga classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fill your days with everything from daily workouts and personal training to racket sports, group yoga classes and more.

verified_facts.text: The resort is on the Northwest coast of Saint Lucia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled on the sunny Northwest coast of Saint Lucia, The Landings Resort and Spa is the ideal starting place for all sorts of exciting adventures on land and sea.

verified_facts.text: For in-suite grocery provisioning, the resort notes island prices may be two to three times higher than U.S. prices.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that island prices maybe 2–3 times higher than that of U.S. prices and may vary due to market conditions.

verified_facts.text: Advance spa reservations are highly recommended.
verified_facts.excerpt: Advance reservations are highly recommended.

verified_facts.text: The Landings Resort and Spa was named in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards in 2019 and 2021.
verified_facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2019, 2021
